name: Get Associated Meetings
description: List meetings associated with a contact, company, or deal in HubSpot. Set **From Object Type** and **Object ID** (for contacts you may pass an email instead of the numeric id). Optionally narrow with **Timeframe** (today, this_week, this_month, last_month, or custom with **Start/End Date**), or set **Most Recent** to return only the latest meeting. Returns up to 100 meetings with default meeting properties. Example: From Object Type `contacts`, Object ID `ada@example.com`, Timeframe `this_month`. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/associations/association-details)
